Report Metadata
Source: Radiology Unit, Maastricht UMC+
Date Issued: 2025-02-10
Modality: Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate
Referred for: PSA elevation to 8.5 ng/mL with a palpable nodule on digital rectal exam.

FINDINGS: Glandular volume registers at 23.08 mL. T2 sequences highlight a circumscribed hypointense focus within the left mid-gland peripheral zone, spanning 12 × 10 × 9 mm. Diffusion-weighted acquisitions show profound restriction with matching low apparent diffusion coefficient values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced phases demonstrate early focal enhancement contrasting against adjacent tissue. Extracapsular spread and seminal vesicle involvement are absent. Pelvic lymph nodes and bone marrow appear normal.

IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left mid-gland peripheral zone. PSAD 0.368 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.87014735.
